deadline_text_verbatim: Submission Deadline: Pre-enrolment applications must be finalized and submitted by June 30, 2026, at 23:59 (Italian time). This allows the University sufficient time to validate applications before the Embassies/Consulates' deadlines for visa issuance.
researcher_notes: Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline for non-EU applicants residing abroad requiring a study visa, 2026-27 AY. Closed as of retrieval (2026-08-21); page gives no indication yet of a 2027-28 AY date, consistent with this being a rolling/next-cycle-not-yet-published gap rather than an omission.
